schema.description: Structurally invalid factor requests, defined in FACTOR SPACE ONLY. Identical for every arm: no well, mode, cluster or any other model-internal structure is referenced, so arms without such structure consume the same file.

kinds.duplicate_factor: two different values of the SAME factor requested simultaneously — unsatisfiable because each image has exactly one value per factor
kinds.out_of_range: a value outside that factor's realised range — unsatisfiable because the grid is exhaustive and closed

record.id: stable string id, unique within the file
record.reason: human-readable statement of why the request cannot be satisfied
record.request: list of {factor, factor_index, value} terms; a well-formed request names each factor at most once with a value drawn from that factor's grid
record.violated_factor: name of the factor whose constraint is violated
